references.credit: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
references.observed: Actually inspected frontal courtyard photograph of the hypostyle screen:four full-height columns with varied floral capitals,low relief panels,open central passage and exposed sky behind the lintel. Do not fill the column hall with a solid roof. Fine reliefs are not copied as textures.

Actually inspected frontal pylon photograph:two broad inward-battered sandstone towers,uneven broken upper courses,a lower central portal with deep open doorway and cornice,vertical torus corners/flagstaff recesses,a raised paved approach and shallow steps.
Actually inspected side of courtyard:free-standing varied floral-capital columns,high rough broken wall behind them,an open side doorway,missing colonnade roof slabs and square stone paving.

Actually inspected full lakeside oblique exterior:pylon and low central portal on the eastern lake-facing end,broken lower court enclosure behind,high column-hall lintel and separate lower rear sanctuary roofs. Rocky island/lake are host context and are excluded.

method: Four ordinary exterior/courtyard photographs actually inspected plus retained individual temple footprint and standard viewer PMTiles/one global terrain tile. No bespoke survey,PDF,archive or downloaded mesh. Photographs remain local and are not redistributed or used as textures.
